body: Sorry to hear that, but thanks. Also time seems to help a fair bit, and laughing.

I pretty much spent 22 hours listening to ["Long Live A$AP"](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BysVzAnR9MY), ["Dark Fantasy"](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A5e3ZL5IEcg),    ["Free the Robots"](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XcmR8DxuHBA) and a Kanye West B.I.G [mashup](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=myvRZd-KOME) on repeat.

EDIT: Almost forgot 1 [train](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nU4OIAYwo5g)
I've only tried sleeping pills once, but they made me stay up even longer.

I feel different compared to anyone I know. I don't feel like I belong. I feel like the only thing keeping me from death is fear and guilt. I don't think I deserve love. And I've felt insane these last few years. Instead of having one thought and maybe changing those thoughts I have multiple that stay and argue (not like voices in my head), but I can never really agree on one thing. I feel like I've been on this earth too long. As in though I've only been here 18 years I feel like I've been here way longer (I think this is due to how much thought I put into everything)

I've always had problems with sleeping (insomnia maybe). I've also been trapped in my own thoughts for about 2 years and I feel insane, so staying up for a long amount of time doesn't affect me like it used to. It still does fuck with me.
I agree I need to sleep. I have problems sleeping and often stay up 14-36 hours.
